name: Gift of Thawing Frost
notes: 7-day v1.0 launch login event; grants Lustrous Tide and a free copy of the 4★ resonator Sanhua. End date inferred as start+7 days, not independently confirmed — see progress.md. The schema has no way to record a character grant as a reward (eventRewards only models currency/material), which is a real gap this event surfaced.
